# dshtui
English | 中文
`dshtui` is a terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`), built on Ink, in the TUI style of ope
ncode. It mounts into a dsh profile as a bundle plugin and takes over the whole terminal interface:
streaming chat, foldable tool cards, dialogs, and a plugin contribution API covering every visible s
ng chat, foldable tool cards, dialogs, and a plugin contribution API covering every visible surface.
This project exists as a plugin of DeepSeek Harness.
## Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0` or `>=24.0.0`
- The `dsh` CLI: `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`
